designationHistory.indexText: Congress authorized the Seal Beach National Wildlife Refuge, within the Naval Weapons Station at Seal Beach, by an act signed by President Richard Nixon on August 29, 1972.

sources.name: U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service: Seal Beach National Wildlife Refuge, About Us
Public Law 92-408, Aug. 29, 1972 (House statutes compilation): act authorizing the Seal Beach National Wildlife Refuge
FWS news release, Sept. 17, 1972: "President Nixon signed a bill August 29, 1972, authorizing establishment of the Seal Beach National Wildlife Refuge" within the Naval Weapons Station
